notes: 🔥 Day streak next to the logo: train or hit your protein goal to keep it lit. Tap it for your best streak and the last 5 weeks.
👀 A small “Yesterday” line under the greeting: calories, protein, workout and last night’s sleep at a glance.
🏆 Trophy wall (Progress → Lifts): every PR you’ve hit, newest first, with a shareable PR card.
🔮 PR predictions: when you’ll hit the next round number on each lift at your current pace.
📅 Monthly wrap: a story-style look back at your month you can share.
🔊 Sounds for sets, PRs, finished workouts and quick adds. Quiet on silent, still plays in earbuds, never pauses your music. Turn them off in You → Appearance.
✨ Smoother screens: tabs slide in the direction you tap, and numbers and rings glide to their new values.
🏋️ Lateral Raise is now called Dumbbell Lateral Raise. Your past sets came with it.
